text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: NA = no cells; 0 = exact zero; <0.1 = positive below 0.1. Non-detection is not biological absence. Literal labels are not validated identities.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Abundance = 1,000,000 x summed gene counts / summed counts across all saved features in the same stratum. Aggregates overlap the label rows.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Counts do not measure receptor protein, signaling, responsiveness, memory, lineage or repair. Non-contaminant uses the original label-prefix rule.
